title: Flags field parsed but never validated
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Lines: 124, 396, 456

Issue: All three message types (Rreq, Rrep, Rerr) have a flags field that is parsed from input and serialized without validation. If the LOADng spec defines specific valid flag bits, invalid combinations should be rejected or logged.

Trigger: Receiving a message with undefined flag bits set - currently silently accepted.

Impact: Unknown flag bits may have meaning in future protocol versions. Accepting them silently could cause interoperability issues or mask malformed messages.

Suggested fix:
1. Document which flag bits are valid (if any are currently defined)
2. Add validation in from_bytes() to reject unknown flags, or
3. Log a warning when unknown flags are seen for debugging
close_reason: Invalid: Flags field being parsed without validation is standard forward-compatible protocol design - unknown flags are ignored, allowing future extensions.
